name: 26-237MR Full Federal Court dismisses appeal by former auditor Reginald Lance Williams
metaDescription: The Full Court of the Federal Court has dismissed an appeal by former registered company auditor Reginald Lance Williams, upholding an earlier judgment and leaving in place a disciplinary decision cancelling his registration as a company auditor.

name: 26-236MR Hollard fined $2 million for serious insurance claim delay
metaDescription: Hollard Insurance Partners Limited (Hollard) has been ordered by the Federal Court to pay a $2 million penalty after Hollard admitted that its serious claim-handling failures left a Victorian family living in appalling conditions, with their home ultimately deemed a total loss.

name: 26-220MR ART amends ASIC’s permanent ban made against Noel Northcott
metaDescription: The Administrative Review Tribunal (ART) has varied ASIC’s decision to permanently ban Noel Northcott from providing financial services and carrying on a financial services business
